page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2a-c1m2.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs provided by an AMD EPYC processor running at a base clock speed of 2.25 GHz. The instance is configured with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource allocation of 2.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance type does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring network-attached block storage for operating system and application data. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps. There are no integrated graphics processing units or specialized hardware accelerators bundled with this configuration, and it includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.u2a-c1m2.xlarge is structured for compute-focused workloads that do not demand large memory footprints. This resource density offers qualitative cost efficiency for applications requiring dedicated CPU execution without the overhead of unused memory. Suitable workloads include lightweight web servers, batch processing, microservices, and build systems that fit within the 8.0 GB memory limit.
